objective: Produce a reproducible and evidence-backed next-stage study plan for Sleep-EDF sleep-stage classification, covering subject-independent evaluation, REM/N1 imbalance handling, baselines, and final reporting without claiming exact replication of the reference paper.
deliverables: A bounded work plan with phases, ownership, dependencies, and stop/acceptance criteria
A proposed subject-independent evaluation protocol using the existing 6-subject Sleep-EDF subset
A proposed REM/N1 imbalance experiment matrix with metrics and decision rules
A final verification and reporting checklist linked to the current project artifacts
nonGoals: Do not claim exact weight-level replication of the 2026 reference paper
Do not download a large external dataset or publish results during the planning phase
Do not change implementation files or start long-running experiments before explicit approval
Do not select a final imbalance strategy from a single held-out subject or a single seed
acceptance: Plan keeps train, validation, and test subjects disjoint and specifies how subject-level leakage is checked
Plan includes at least 3 model seeds or a leave-one-subject-out design and reports mean, sample standard deviation, and per-stage F1
Plan compares a conservative baseline with at least one REM/N1-targeted imbalance strategy using fixed split seeds
Plan defines reproducibility checks: py_compile, JSON schema/config validation, dataset integrity, and report update
Plan identifies remaining compute, dataset-size, and generalization risks explicitly

doneWhen: Return a compact evaluation protocol, compute estimate, and leakage/acceptance checks
Return an imbalance experiment matrix, metric thresholds, and a decision rule for REM/N1

decisions: Planning only until the user explicitly approves with proceed or equivalent wording
Use the existing 6-subject Sleep-EDF subset first; external validation is a later phase
Keep split_seed fixed when comparing model seeds or imbalance strategies
Treat REM and N1 per-stage F1 as first-class metrics alongside accuracy and macro-F1
